'''Ernisto Misar''' was a [[Drall/Legends|Drall]] who worked as an environmental specialist and [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
In [[3640 BBY]], [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] Misar discovered that the [[Battle of Corellia|fighting]] in the factory had ruptured its main pipelines, causing toxic chemicals to spill into one of the [[City/Legends|city's]] aquifers. He requested a Republic citizen to acquire spare parts from an area guarded by enemy droids, after which his clan was able to repair the pipelines thanks to the Republic efforts.
